payout_quote: The person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $150 Visa Reward Card for each individual or a $50 Visa Reward Card for each business referred (Referred Person) to Provident Credit Union that registers for the offer, opens a new personal or business checking account and completes the other requirements.
steps: Register for the Provident Credit Union referral program on their website and get your referral link.
Share the offer with friends, family, or coworkers by email or social media.
Your friend registers via your link and opens a new Provident personal checking account (for your $150 reward) or business checking account (for your $50 reward).

Within 60 days of account opening, your friend completes: $400+ in debit/credit card purchases AND $500+ in direct deposits/automatic credits, and keeps the account open and in good standing for 60 days.
Your Visa Reward Card is mailed to the physical address on your program registration 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed.
catches: The payout is a Visa Reward Card (not cash) - and note the split: you get $150 per friend who opens personal checking, only $50 per business checking referral.
Cap: $500 in Visa Reward Cards per calendar year (about 3 personal-checking referrals).
Friend requirements are demanding: $400 in card purchases PLUS $500 in direct deposits within 60 days, and the account must stay open 60 days.
The increased reward offer is subject to change at any time without notice.
Youth Checking accounts are ineligible; members must be 18+; Provident CU employees ineligible.
Reward Card may be reported as income to the IRS.
Only one Referrer may receive the Reward Card for each Referred Person.
biggest_catch: Your $150 depends on your friend completing $400 in purchases AND $500 in direct deposits within 60 days - and you're capped at $500 per calendar year.
eligibility: Provident Credit Union referral program registrants (18+); referred person must be a new personal/business checking account holder. Employees ineligible.
timing: Visa Reward Card mailed 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed.
